name: Goblin Beast Marshal

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description:
Thicker and heavier than leather, hide armor is composed of skin from any creature that has a tough hide, such as a bear, a griffon, or a dragon. Hide armor can bind and slightly hinder your precision, but it’s light enough that it doesn’t affect your speed.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Hide armor grants +4 AC at levels 16-25, and +5 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: Arrows are used up when you fire them from a projectile weapon.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

traits.name: Last Instinct
traits.details: When any allied beast in the aura drops to 0 hit points, the beast can make a basic attack.

auras.name: Last Instinct
auras.details: When any allied beast in the aura drops to 0 hit points, the beast can make a basic attack.

effect.description: One allied beast within 10 squares of the goblin can use a free action to shift half its speed and make a melee attack in either order.

powers.name: Block the Escape
powers.trigger: An enemy within 5 squares of the goblin moves.

effect.description: The goblin and one allied beast within 5 squares of the triggering enemy can each shift half its speed.

powers.name: Goblin Tactics
powers.trigger: The goblin is missed by an attack.
